data.gender_notes: Kamraj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Kamraj is a name derived from the Sanskrit language, associated with the Hindu deity Kamadeva, the god of desire and love. The name Kamraj refers to the power or influence of Kamadeva, the enchanting and mystical power of love. The name Kamraj carries the meaning “God of Black Magic” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kamraj usually hope their child will grow to embody god of black magic and live with faith, good character and purpose.
